title: Smart Data Models - ERA RINF - LinearPositioningSystem
description:
Linear Positioning System (era:LinearPositioningSystem's own definition, verbatim, in the source ontology): Represents a linear positioning system used for referencing positions on the network.
It can also represent a sequence of one or more sections of line, used for regular railway operations.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'LinearPositioningSystem'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

lineId.description: Property. Unique line identification or unique line number within Member State. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.0.0.0.2)

lrsMethod.description: Property. The preferred line referencing system. Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'Line reference systems' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/lines/ReferenceSystems), 6 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.

netReference.description: Relationship. The reference that a physical infrastructure element has it on the topology. It may be used to define the positioning or a representation as a point, line or area
